parsed.segment_function: The target block contains unparsed or corrupted text encoding glyphs (Unicode escape-like tokens such as 2u96/A) representing bibliographic references or citations, rendering the text unusable for extracting semantic claims.
unresolved_context: The block consists entirely of encoded character sequences or unrendered text tokens (e.g., 2u96/A2u96/82u9675) which prevent extraction of substantive semantic claims or definitions.
